title: Modular Building Replacement - Border Patrol Big Bend Marfa Sector HQ in Marfa, TX
agency: GENERAL SERVICES ADMINISTRATION.PUBLIC BUILDINGS SERVICE.PBS PROJECT DELIVERY CAPITAL CONSTRUCTION - BRANCH CENTRAL
description_text: This project is available to the awardees of the small business construction MATOC in the Border McAllen area. The contracted work provides for design and construction services for two new modular buildings and the demolition of three existing modular buildings.
